structural_observation.claim: Where single-dimension presence-based selectors failed 5 times, published work that succeeds uses composite, conditioned signals jointly.
structural_observation.assessment: GENUINELY UNCERTAIN - both a selection-effect explanation (published papers don't report composite-failures against a matched placebo the way this project's own selectors failed) and a genuine-mechanism explanation (presence-marks-the-market-for-others is a different question from a specific-trader's-own-multi-factor-profile-predicts-their-own-outcome) are plausible. Not resolved by this pass.
structural_observation.explanation: S3-8 tests a property of an already-validated cohort, not a new composite selector. S2-1/S2-2/S3-1/S5-2 are calibration, diagnostic, and data-integrity questions, not selector tests.
structural_observation.why_excluded_not_invented: S5-1 is the direct empirical test of the structural question but has not escaped the placebo objection as currently specified - excluded per the discipline this pass is required to apply, not because it lacks conceptual value. Stated plainly rather than inventing a substitute candidate to fill the gap.

shortlist.question: Does execution timing correlate with directional accuracy or realized edge within the directional-skill harness's already-validated cohort?
shortlist.why_on_list: HIGH decidability, HIGH consequence both directions. Original n=4 finding untrustworthy at that size; instr_v7's validated cohort didn't exist when RQ-EXEC-001 was last touched. The one remaining open execution-adjacent door after copy-trade capture and presence-based mispricing both closed.
shortlist.negative_result_meaning: If timing does not correlate (or reverses again, this time at real power), that cleanly closes the 'entry timing is the execution dimension' hypothesis - a well-powered narrowing, not a wasted test.
shortlist.first_concrete_step: Pull instr_v7's cohort membership, compute each trader's entry-time percentile (absolute via instr_v3/tape_end, relative via built_b3/timing_score) against realized directional accuracy and edge, using instr_v5's clustered bootstrap for the CI.

shortlist.question: Does re-weighting own_market_calibration.py by position size, not price, reproduce the external paper's rising-with-horizon shape?
shortlist.why_on_list: Resolves this pass's own headline external conflict (jobB_1) at very low cost with an already-validated instrument.
shortlist.negative_result_meaning: If the re-weighted slope still falls with horizon, weighting is ruled out, narrowing remaining candidates to population breadth or a genuine unexplained conflict - cheap enough that a null result costs almost nothing.
shortlist.first_concrete_step: Re-run own_market_calibration.py with position-size weighting substituted for price-weighting, same population and lead-time bins, compare slope-by-horizon shape directly.

synthesis.where_the_project_stands: A genuinely validated instrument stack now exists (PIT reconstruction, price_at, canonical backtest population, bootstrap/cap5/EB-shrinkage, match_control, directional-skill harness, own-market calibration), built specifically in response to a thoroughly condemned predecessor (geo_elo/comprehensive_elo/LEGENDARY). The pivot was real, not cosmetic. Headline finding surviving all five passes: directional skill is real and statistically persistent (37.0% vs 18.6%) but has not converted into a capturable, tradeable signal via any selector tried so far - 5 falsified selectors, 4 via the same activity-matched-placebo mechanism, a convergent pattern across independently-designed tests. The project's own working explanation (execution not information drives profit, Della Vedova-style) has independent external mechanism support (jobB_4) though no external replication of the specific pattern was found.
synthesis.most_decision_relevant_unresolved_fact: The result of record itself (metric_v2f_oos_result, data_d7) remains NULL-UNDERPOWERED after ~5 weeks and several related analyses - not negative. This is the honest center of gravity: the thesis has not yet been tested at adequate power, and the obvious ways to act on a positive belief in it have independently failed for a different, well-understood reason (execution, not selection).
synthesis.administrative_drift_alongside_research_: 25 of 35 named research questions never run, dropped for cost/attention-shift not evidence. Strategy registry silently stale 3 months. Tier-3 agent pause (cost-driven) also happened to starve at least one underpowered result (STR-003) of the data that would resolve it. Relevance-classifier adjudication institutionally outstanding. Not a research failure - the ordinary cost of a fast-moving ~10-month project outrunning its own bookkeeping - but real, and pass 2's register is the first place it was all counted in one place.

coverage_gap.docs_read_across_passes: ~48-54 (pass 1: 24 in depth; pass 2: ~24 more primary pre-registration/result documents, some overlap; passes 3-4 did not add new project-corpus reading by design)
coverage_gap.what_this_leaves_uncertain: Any RQ, arc, or finding mentioned only in the unread ~190 is invisible to this entire shortlist. Three large primary pre-registrations never read in full (discovery-gap-closure's founding prereg at 1883 lines, copy-trade-decay prereg's middle sections, price-substitution-verification doc) could contain additional stop-conditions or caveats affecting how confidently any candidate's 'why isn't this already closed' field should be trusted. The shortlist is built on a genuinely rigorous but incomplete base - strongest set of candidates given what five passes actually found, not proof nothing better exists in the unread remainder. The not-worth-doing list is provisional against this gap, not a closed verdict.
